content.title: DOWNTOWN STORRS
content.text: Welcome to Downtown Storrs! Downtown Storrs is where rural life meets urban living and where "town" meets "gown." Located in the Town of Mansfield, Connecticut next to UConn, Downtown Storrs is home to more than 70 businesses, two nature preserves with over three miles of hiking trails, the internationally-renowned Ballard Institute and Museum of Puppetry, and much more! EAT. Enjoy tasty cuisines from all around the globe at more than twenty eateries, all downtown. FIND DINING EXPLORE. Over 200 acres of preserved woodlands; a community playground and skate park; a world-renown museum of puppetry - all await you downtown. Start exploring ENJOY. Live music, poetry and prose, family-friendly and community events - enjoy them all downtown.
